title: Code structure consolidation
objective: Consolidate repeated GPU contracts/layout rules and execution ownership, remove redundant preparation and preview mechanics, and make current module/preview interfaces coherent while preserving behavior and bounded work.
context_summary: The GPU-first refactor is integrated. A structural review identifies one exported provider availability defect, mirrored GPU primitives/layout rules across core/UI/desktop, a reusable executor inside widgets, repeated stream preparation, partial public module APIs, string-based operation identity, loose preview state, repeated grid/loupe mechanisms and small ownership/helper/comment cleanup. Core/UI/CLI/reference boundaries and distinct quality/memory strategies remain. Implementation is authorized by the owner on 2026-10-07. The proposed pure-contract plus Iced-free backend split still requires explicit approval of TASK-003 before its dependent extraction tasks start. All tasks re-review current main before starting; minimum model is the roadmap high tier. Native qualification and performance claims are deferred to the finished integrated branch, with no cross-plan dependencies or total-memory claim.

tasks.description: Qualify and measure the integrated structural refactor on current production paths.
extra_context: All implementation outputs must be integrated before qualification/timing. This task is the single final performance/measurement owner; each earlier task still runs its scoped and required integration checks.

No tolerance/budget increase to make a refactor pass. Software/VM/no-GPU evidence is separate from native GPU evidence; skipped/incomplete is not passed.
GPU accounting keeps current scope; total-memory claims remain dependent by named capability on complete accounting of all excluded resources, not on this structural plan.
